nodes.body: Fixed: queued and delegated runs keep the original operator's permission limits and honor later revocation.

I found one security-boundary concern in the new operator-authority capability.

"createAdmittedRunOperatorAuthority()" is documented as host-only, but it is exported and acts as the authority minting primitive. Since it accepts the profile, scopes, source, and currentness callback from its caller, "assertAdmittedRunOperatorAuthority()" only proves that the value passed through this factory, not that it originated from a trusted Gateway admission path.

Please either make the minting path non-exported/internal or add an explicit trusted issuer boundary so extensions/internal callers cannot manufacture arbitrary operator capabilities.

Aside from that, the PR has good coverage around queue retention, revocation, FIFO authority separation, overflow cleanup, and child-run cleanup. The capability lifetime/cleanup handling is also substantially exercised by the new tests.
